name: Norikawa Kouta
source:
Minami's brother-in-law.
He lost his parents at a young age and was raised by Minami’s family, who were his relatives.
As he grew older, he began to harbor feelings for Minami that went beyond those of a brother for a sister,
but he sensed that those around him did not approve,
so he decided to distance himself from Minami by moving away to attend college.
However, a year later, when his sister followed him to Tokyo, his feelings began to resurface...
